name: Iede Kanojo
source:
Yui was a runaway girl crashing on the couches of friends. She snuck into Satoshi's apartment, a guy who edited DVD projects as a side job. He came home and caught her rummaging through his bedroom.

Both of them caught in a strange situation, Yui negotiated a deal.

For one month's stay, she'd be part of his DVD productions. Their relationship takes a series of twists and turns.

Meanwhile, Satoshi's part-time job boss finds out about Yui. He offers her a job and she starts working at the same place. Yui's wanted a place to fit in for so long...

What will she do to find where she belongs in this world? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE086990.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
结衣是个离家出走的女孩，一直借住在不同朋友的沙发上。她偷偷闯进聪的公寓；聪有一份替人剪辑DVD作品的副业，回家后正好撞见结衣在卧室里翻找东西。

两人陷入了尴尬局面，结衣于是提出一项交易。

聪让她住一个月，而她会参与聪的DVD制作。两人的关系从此经历一连串曲折变化。

与此同时，聪兼职工作的老板发现了结衣。他向她提供一份工作，于是结衣也开始在同一个地方上班。长久以来，她一直渴望找到属于自己的容身之处……

为了找到自己在这个世界上的归宿，她会作出怎样的选择？

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE086990.html]DLsite English[/url]]
